def fractionToDecimal(numerator: int, denominator: int) -> str:
    if numerator % denominator == 0:
        return str(numerator // denominator)
    
    # Determine the sign of the result
    sign = '-' if (numerator < 0) ^ (denominator < 0) else ''
    
    # Work with absolute values to simplify the logic
    numerator, denominator = abs(numerator), abs(denominator)
    
    # Get the integer part
    integer_part = numerator // denominator
    remainder = numerator % denominator
    
    # Start forming the decimal part
    decimal_part = []
    seen_remainders = {}
    
    # Process the fractional part
    while remainder != 0:
        if remainder in seen_remainders:
            # Repeating part found
            start_index = seen_remainders[remainder]
            non_repeating = ''.join(map(str, decimal_part[:start_index]))
            repeating = ''.join(map(str, decimal_part[start_index:]))
            return f"{sign}{integer_part}.{non_repeating}({repeating})"
        
        # Record the position of this remainder
        seen_remainders[remainder] = len(decimal_part)
        
        # Multiply remainder by 10 and get the next digit
        remainder *= 10
        digit = remainder // denominator
        decimal_part.append(digit)
        
        # Update remainder
        remainder %= denominator
    
    # No repeating part
    return f"{sign}{integer_part}." + ''.join(map(str, decimal_part))
